in_sanskrit.name: Sheela
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Shining, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sheela एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sheela is a beautiful and radiant name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sheetala', which means 'shining' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Sheela is associated with the goddess Parvati and is believed to bring calmness, peace, and tranquility.
